text:
alisa: alerting — p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~180ms to ~1.2s right after the canary deploy (canary-2026-03-xx). grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/serving/latency?panel=generate :rotating_light:
ben: saw it. is this the kernel-autoselect flip we enabled in the canary? it changed heuristics for small-seq vs long-seq
mike: devops-bot shows deploy job: deploy/canary/2026-03-xx by ci-bot at 1858501200. listing recent config diffs: kernel.autoselect=on, kv.prefetch_policy=aggressive, microbatch.max=8
sophia: that combo smells bad for small-seq requests. aggressive prefetch + larger microbatch can queue a request behind longer in-flight work = tail blowup
alisa: grabbing a pprof from a problematic host now. shorttrace: https://traces.redwood/trace/abc123
mike: attaching flame snippet (top 10):
```
  35%  runtime_kernel_select
  20%  kv_prefetch_worker
  15%  microbatch_queue_wait
  10%  attention_kernels (fp16)
  8%   cudaMemcpy
  12%  other
```
ben: runtime_kernel_select jumping to 35% — that correlates with the new autoselect path doing extra model-mapping work on small sequences
oncall-rot: can we test a quick mitigation? suggested: pin kernel.autoselect=false on canary and set kv.prefetch_policy=passive, microbatch.max=1 for smallseq route
sophia: agree. i can push a hot config patch to canary runtime config. command: `rdwctl deploy-config --env canary --set kernel.autoselect=false --set kv.prefetch_policy=passive --set microbatch.max=1`
alisa: doing it now. will monitor p99 in the next 60s
devops-bot: config-update/canary applied by sophia. build: cfg-7853. rolling to 4 nodes
(monitor updates)
mike: after config flip — p99 dropped to ~210ms within 45s. p95 steady. looks like prefetch + batching were amplifying the kernel selection cost into tail latency
ben: ok push a revert for the kernel-autoselect logic in the canary branch and plan a safer rollout (metrics gating + smallseq perf test). create PR and link it here
sophia: PR created: https://git.redwood/infer/runtime/-/merge_requests/912 hotfix: revert kernel-autoselect and add unit/integration perf test for small sequences
devops-bot: deploy/revert-job started for canary. job id 9912. rolling back cfg-7853 -> cfg-7840
oncall-rot: canary revert finished. p99 steady ~190-220ms, no error increase. marking incident mitigated. :white_check_mark:
alisa: filing follow-up incident note and adding a perf test to the canary gating. also we should add a microbench for kv.prefetch on small sequences before we re-enable aggressive modes
mike: also logging flamegraphs + perf counters to the runbook entry: https://docs.redwood/ops/latency-runbook#kernel-autoselect
ben: nice rapid chase. postmortem: keep kernel.autoselect behind feature-flag + perf test for microbatch sizes. I'll own the rollout plan
sophia: thumbs up. closing thread once PR is merged and a postmortem linked
